name: recut-prevention
title: Close the gaps that let four same-version re-cuts happen
description: v0.12.3 and v0.12.4 were each republished twice. The second v0.12.4 re-cut fixed a regression the first one introduced (the combat gate read RunManager's action queue on the main menu, failing every /state with a NullReferenceException) and neither 408 C# tests nor nine offline gates caught it. This round adds the missing prevention: a source contract for the in-combat guard, the first documentation of the /state combat payload plus a gate that pins it, build fingerprints emitted by packaging, and an Unreleased convention so a post-tag fix has somewhere to live.
creator: CharTyr
notes: Documentation, tests and scripts only. No runtime mod code changed, so the published 0.12.4 build is unaffected.
